sharedRules.name: Dawnguard Wardog
sharedRules.description: If the target of [this model's] Melee Attack is a Vampire, the attack gains the Follow-Up (1) keyword.

sharedRules.name: Packmates
sharedRules.description: If both Bran and Sceolang are included in the same Party, they count as a single Familiar for the purposes of Force creation.

sharedRules.name: Troll Strike
sharedRules.description: When [this model] performs a Power Attack Boost, it adds [RED] instead of [YELLOW] to the attack roll.

rules.name: Uncompromising Commander
rules.description: Friendly Dawnguard Faction models gain the Bodyguard (Isran) keyword while within 3" of Isran.  In addition, when Isran performs a Melee Attack [targeting] a Vampire, and there are any Civilians within 3", add [RED] to the Attack.  When the Attack is complere, roll the Skill Die - on a [CRITICAL FAIL], remove the nearest [Civilian] NPC Token as a casualty and lose 1VP.

rules.name: Tamer of Trolls
rules.description: When Gunmar is in the Party, you may include one extra Armored Troll (in addition to the usual Familiar maximum).  Furthermore, whenever Gunmar issues a With Me! Command to a friendly Armored Troll, the Troll adds [YELLOW] to its Attacks for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Quick Hands
rules.description: Ingjard may exchange an equipped Crossbow for another Weapon in her inventory as a Free Action, even while Engaged.
